prompt:
Our team runs a local AI development environment with models, prompts, and conversation data stored in `/workspace/ai_workspace`. We've had two incidents this month where accidental deletions caused us to lose hours of work, and we're worried about what happens if the primary storage fails entirely.

I need you to implement a proper three-layer workspace protection system for this environment using the backup skill available in our toolset (see SKILL.md). The system should automatically protect our workspace at `/workspace/ai_workspace`, store daily backups in `/workspace/backups_dir`, and mirror everything to `/workspace/mirror_drive` as a secondary safety net.

Please create two files:
1. `daily-backup.ps1` — the main backup script with all paths configured and the correct default retention policy
2. `register-task.ps1` — a script to register the backup as an automated scheduled job

Make sure the retention policy, scheduling time, sync method, and task name all match exactly what the skill documentation specifies.
